corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: 19th November, 2026 BSE Limited National Stock Exchange of India Limited Department of Corporate Services Listing Department Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers Exchange Plaza Dalal Street Bandra-Kurla Complex Mumbai 400 001 Bandra (East), Mumbai 400 051 Scrip Code: 500575 NSE Symbol: VOLTAS Dear Sirs, Sub: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Update on the Proposed Joint Venture with Atomberg Innovation Private Limited This is in furtherance to our disclosure dated 14th August, 2026, wherein we had informed that the Board of Directors of the Voltas Limited (‘Company’ / ‘Voltas’) had approved entering into a Binding Term Sheet with Atomberg Innovation Private Limited (‘AIPL’), a subsidiary of Atomberg Technologies Limited, for setting up a Joint Venture in India for the development, manufacture and commercialization of room air-conditioner compressors. Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (‘SEBI Listing Regulations’), we hereby inform that Voltas has today, i.e. 19th November, 2026, executed a Joint Venture Agreement (‘JVA’) with AIPL for setting up the aforesaid Joint Venture. In terms of the JVA, Atomberg Airtech Private Limited ("AAPL"), an existing wholly owned subsidiary of AIPL, shall be the joint venture entity. Voltas shall acquire 50% of the equity share capital of AAPL from AIPL upon Closing, as contemplated under the JVA, resulting in both parties holding equal shareholding in the Joint Venture. Voltas shall have the right to control the composition of the Board of Directors of AAPL and, accordingly, AAPL shall become a subsidiary of Voltas upon completion of the transaction. The name of AAPL is proposed to be changed following the Closing of the transaction. The Closing is subject to the satisfactory fulfilment of the conditions precedent set out in the JVA. The information as required under Para A of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI Listing Regulations read with relevant SEBI Circulars is enclosed in the Annexure. Scrip Code: 539523 Scrip Symbol: ALKEM Sub: Update on US FDA Inspection at Company’s manufacturing facility located at Amaliya, Daman Dear Sir/Madam, This is in continuation of our earlier intimations dated August 6, 2026 and May 2, 2026, regarding the US FDA inspection conducted at the Company’s manufacturing facility located at Amaliya, Daman, from April 20, 2026 to May 1, 2026. The US FDA had classified the inspection status of the said facility as Official Action Indicated (OAI). This is to inform you that US FDA has issued a warning letter dated November 18, 2026 for Company’s manufacturing facility located at Amaliya, Daman. corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: (An ISO 9001:2015; ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001:2018 certified company) CIN: L85110KA1954PLC000759; Website: www.sandurgroup.com Email ID: secretarial@sandurgroup.com REGISTERED OFFICE CORPORATE OFFICE ‘SATYALAYA’, No.266 ‘SANDUR HOUSE’, No.9 Ward No.1, Palace Road Bellary Road, Sadashivanagar Sandur – 583 119, Ballari District Bengaluru – 560 080 Karnataka, India Karnataka, India Tel: 08395 260300 Tel: 080 31098028 SMIORE / SEC / 2026-27 / 66 19 November 2026 BSE Limited National Stock Exchange of India Limited Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block G Dalal Street Bandra-Kurla Complex Mumbai - 400 001 Mumbai - 400 051 Scrip Code: 504918 Symbol: SANDUMA Symbol: SANDUMA Dear Sir/ Madam, Sub: Press and Media Release Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) “SEBI (LODR)” Regulations, 2015, please find attached herewith copy of the Press and Media Release titled “Sandur plans ₹280 crore beneficiation capex, targets up to 1.7 MTPA of upgraded ore output” which is being released today. Stock Exchanges are requested to kindly take the same on record. Thank you for The Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores Limited Neha Thomas Company Secretary & Compliance Officer ICSI Membership No. A60853 Encl: A/a MINES OFFICE: Deogiri - 583112, Sandur Taluk, Ballari District; Tel: 08395 271028 PLANT OFFICE: Metal & Ferroalloy Plant, Vyasankere, Mariyammanahalli – 583 222, Hosapete Taluk, Vijayanagara District; Tel: 08394 294802 / 805 Sandur plans ₹280 crore beneficiation capex, targets up to 1.7 MTPA of upgraded ore output First 3.5 MTPA unit at Deogiri is targeted for commissioning in August 2027; beneficiation process is expected to improve Fe (iron) content from about 50% to over 60%. Bengaluru, 19th November: The Sandur Manganese & Iron Ores Limited (SMIORE/the Company) (NSE: SANDUMA; BSE: 504918) plans to invest approximately ₹280 crore in its first in-mine iron ore beneficiation plant at Deogiri Village in Sandur Taluk, Ballari District, Karnataka. The first 3.5 MTPA unit is expected to produce 1.0-1.2 MTPA of upgraded iron ore initially, with potential output of up to 1.7 MTPA. The plant will process ore from SMIORE’s KTIO mines and some ore from its Deogiri mines. It is designed to upgrade lower-grade iron ore, with iron content of about 50% Fe, into concentrate with more than 60% Fe, suitable for pellet manufacturing. The project is being implemented in two phases, with a long-term plan for two 3.5 MTPA units. The first unit is currently about 25% complete, with civil works progressing, structural fabrication under way and orders for long-lead items placed. Commissioning is targeted for August 2027. The project is expected to be funded through a combination of debt and internal accruals. Bahirji A. Ghorpade, Managing Director, said “This will improve the quality and marketability of lower-grade ore, reduce waste and support better revenue realisation. The pellet plants in and around Sandur have an aggregate capacity of more than 24 MTPA. The beneficiated material could also support iron-making within the Group’s integrated steel value chain.” The mine-head location is expected to reduce the transportation of waste-bearing ore and support tailings management. The project is expected to generate 150–200 direct and indirect jobs. SMIORE reported consolidated total income of ₹1,519 crore for Q2 FY27, up 22% year on year. EBITDA increased 37% to ₹391

corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: BDL/PKL/SEC/2026-27 19th November, 2026 To, The Manager Listing Department National Stock Exchange of India Limited Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block-G Bandra Kurla Complex Bandra East Mumbai 400051 SYMBOL: BETA Re:- Press Release Pursuant to Regulation 30 of Listing Regulations- Beta Drugs Limited (“Beta”) forms Oncology Joint Venture with IMGSA Groupe SPA (“IMGSA”) Dear Madam/Sir We are pleased to inform you that the Beta Drugs Limited (“Beta”) forms Oncology Joint Venture with IMGSA Groupe SPA (“IMGSA”) in Algeria. Please find enclosed a copy of the press release being issued in this regard. Kindly take the above information on record. Thanking You Your’s faithfully For Beta Drugs Ltd. Rajni Brar Company Secretary Beta Drugs Limited (“Beta”) forms Oncology Joint Venture with IMGSA Groupe SPA (“IMGSA”) JV to acquire IMGSA’s oncology formulation plant for US$8.7 million; Beta to hold 49% and manage the operations of the JV Panchkula, Nov 19th, 2026 – Beta Drugs Limited (“Beta” or “the Company”) today announced that it has entered into a joint venture (“JV”) with IMGSA Groupe SPA (“IMGSA”), a prominent and leading pharmaceutical and medical devices company in Algeria. Beta will hold a 49% stake in the JV, with the remaining 51% held by IMGSA (the “Transaction”). The JV will acquire IMGSA’s oncology formulation plant for a total consideration of US$8.7 million. The plant is among few plants in Algeria for manufacturing of oncology formulations and has been qualified by Algerian regulatory authority for supply in Algeria tenders. Algeria oncology market is primarily a tender market and there has been a consistent impetus provided by the government of Algeria for localisation of pharmaceutical manufacturing. From a long-standing partnership to an equity partnership IMGSA is one of Algeria’s leading healthcare companies, with an established presence across antibiotics, insulins and medical devices. The group has a diversified industrial presence in Algeria through its operations in the field of agriculture, chemicals and other industrial sectors including healthcare and pharmaceuticals. Beta has had a long-standing relationship with IMGSA over the last 4 years, during which Beta has supplied semi-finished and finished formulations to IMGSA and assisted IMGSA in product registrations for Algeria market. The product registrations would be transferred to the JV as part of the Transaction. The JV is intended to deepen the partnership between Beta and IMGSA. By moving from a supplier to an Equity investor, the two companies expect to broaden the relationship and align their long-term interests in building a strong oncology business in Algeria and North African markets. IMGSA is a leading exporter of pharmaceuticals to Tunisia, Mauritania and other North African markets and the JV will leverage the distribution network of IMGSA to cater to these markets. Transaction structure • The JV will acquire the oncology plant from IMGSA for a total consideration of US$8.7 million. • Part of the consideration to be settled by issue equity shares to IMGSA. • Beta will infuse US$ 3 Million in the JV over a period of 3 years. • Beta will transfer formulation technology to the JV as part of the Transaction . Acquisition of Oncology formulation plant As part of the Transaction, the plant being acquired by the JV has manufacturing capabilities in both injectable and oral solid dosage forms, giving the JV a broad platform to produce a range of oncology products locally i
